objective: Prepare AdMob Mediation pilot and correct Android Wall sponsored NativeAd lifecycle on eligibility reentry, without increasing ad density or touching unrelated features.
productionBaselineEvidence: Reconciled against GitHub main 84d4ca8a22dbba5828443982ce858fa35e7359b6 at 2026-11-01 PH. AdMob PRs #464, #470, #471 merged. Existing production app-side sample showed 450 entry-banner requests, 45 impression callbacks, 114 no-fill failures; later nine-session sample 35 requests and 3 impression callbacks; not a live revenue uplift estimate. Exact Android OTA update ID/fingerprint not verified. No partner adapters/AdMob dashboard activation in this scope.
chosenApproach: Keep already-merged Wall native media and placements unchanged. In the Android native sponsored component, clear the stale SDK handle and one-shot request/loaded refs when eligibility is lost so later online/foreground/consent recovery cannot render a destroyed ad; reuse shared reservation cooldown for any future request. Document a dashboard-first mediation pilot and require native rebuild when a partner adapter is necessary.
selectionRationale: Correct a specific root-cause lifecycle bug without new requests per tap/post, without duplicating merged #470 sponsored cards, and without adding unapproved or incompatible mediation adapters.
alternativeApproaches: Increase Wall post density again: rejected; already delivered in #470 and not relevant to this lifecycle risk.
Disable cooldown to force ads after every return: rejected; increases no-fill requests, invalid ad pressure and network load.
Add arbitrary bidding adapters now: rejected; needs partner approval, compatible native SDK and separate binary, not OTA.
Reset destroyed SDK handle on eligibility revocation while preserving controlled requests: selected.
preserveBehaviors: Existing Public/Org/Cluster Wall ad cadence and placement IDs unchanged.
NativeMediaView/provider creative and real impression callbacks only, no fabricated billable events.
AdMob unit IDs, privacy/consent/route safety remote kill switches and original cooldown remain unchanged.
No changes to feed image/video rendering, recycled scroll position or user posts.
No changes to personal chat composers, calls, Quiz, Bible, KL, Profile or authentication.
No new native dependencies or AdMob console modifications; runtime 1.3.2 production OTA gate preserved.
acceptanceChecks: Focused regression tests and Engineering Accountability scope gate pass on exact PR head.
TypeScript and platform QA pass; Android device reentry/scroll tests still required.
Background/foreground and offline/online recover without using destroyed NativeAd, duplicate requests or stale banner loaded state.
No-fill and absent Native unit keep genuine banner fallback with shared cooldown.
Mediation bidder approval, mapping and Android adapter compatibility independently verified in AdMob dashboard before activation.
No production/RC/live claim without exact source, runtime, verified RC, OTA and device acceptance; adapters require new APK.
